Phi-4-answer.notes: Answers empty after strip() were regenerated with Hugging Face greedy decoding and a logits processor that blocks EOS and newline-only tokens until the generated text is non-whitespace (non-empty greedy outputs are unchanged). vLLM and Hugging Face greedy decoding agree on short answers but can diverge late in long run-on answers (numerical differences); on a 30-question check the outputs were identical for 9/30 (Llama-3 8B) and 22/30 (Phi-4).
